# Linda R. Olsson, Inc., Realtor

> Palm Beach, Florida real estate brokerage specializing in luxury homes and condominiums. Linda R. Olsson is the broker-owner. The firm was founded in 1989 and represents buyers and sellers of Palm Beach properties, from pieds-à-terre to oceanfront estates.

## Contact
- Website: https://www.lindaolsson.com/
- Office: 211A Royal Poinciana Way, Palm Beach, FL 33480
- Office telephone: +1-561-820-9195
- Cell (Linda R. Olsson): +1-561-329-4044
- Email: Linda@LindaOlsson.com
- Contact form: https://www.lindaolsson.com/contact

## About the firm
- Founded in 1989 by Linda R. Olsson, broker-owner
- Over 30 years specializing in Palm Beach luxury properties
- Linda has been a Palm Beach resident and active community member since 1998
- Member of the Palm Beach and regional multiple listing services (MLS)
- Known for confidentiality, negotiation skills, and in-depth local market knowledge

## Recognition
- Recognized by the Wall Street Journal / RealTrends among the top 1,000 real estate professionals in the United States ("America's Best Real Estate Agents")
- Ranked among the top 10 agents in Palm Beach
- 5-star Google reviews
- Press coverage: https://www.lindaolsson.com/palm-beach-florida-real-estate-news

## Services
- Buyer representation
- Seller representation, including listing, marketing, and negotiation
- Leasing of Palm Beach residences
- Relocation guidance for buyers moving to Florida
- Post-transaction referrals: household staff, estate management, legal counsel, craftsmen, architects, builders, and interior designers
- Property marketing: professional photography, advertising in the Wall Street Journal "Mansion" section and Palm Beach publications, direct mail, email, social media, and syndication to sites including Realtor.com, Zillow, and Trulia

## Property types
- Oceanfront and waterfront estates
- Single-family homes
- Luxury condominiums and co-op buildings
- Townhomes
- Land

## Service areas
- Palm Beach: North End, In-Town, Estate Section, and Sloan's Curve south to Manalapan
- Surrounding Palm Beach County communities, including Manalapan, Jupiter Island, and golf course communities
- Clients come from throughout the United States and internationally
